title: Byte streams tracking bug
body:
This is a tracking bug for progress on byte stream standardization.

Status:
- We've recently switched to adopt async read() (see #253).
- #176 is now obsolete.

Sub issues:
- [x] #361 Add reference impl
- [x] Sync spec text with reference impl
  - [x] #417 ReadableByteStreamController internal slots
  - [x] #416 ReadableByteStreamController.close()
- [ ] #177 Requirements doc: Summarized in the "Byte Streams" section in [Requirements.md](https://github.com/whatwg/streams/blob/master/Requirements.md).
  - [x] #301 Additional note about flow control design philosophy
- [x] #294 Naming the reader getter methods
- [x] #295 Return type and argument type of reader.read()
  - Accepts any ArrayBufferView
  - Returns `{ value: view, done }`
  - BYOB: Returns (fulfill the promise with) the same type ArrayBufferView. E.g. if a Float32Array is given, return a Float32Array
  - Non-BYOB: Returns `Uint8Array`
    - [ ] https://github.com/whatwg/streams/issues/177#issuecomment-83991120 Should the stream code enforce the return value to be `Uint8Array`?
    - [ ] https://github.com/yutakahirano/fetch-with-streams/issues/35#issuecomment-92442082 should we let this be customizable?
- [x] `read(view)` algorithm
  - Rough design: https://github.com/whatwg/streams/issues/177#issuecomment-83984473
  - [x] How to handle non 1 BYTES_PER_ELEMENT ArrayBufferViews: https://github.com/whatwg/streams/issues/295#issuecomment-111044231
  - https://github.com/whatwg/streams/issues/177#issuecomment-83991120 just return the contents of the queue first
  - [x] Regarding the queue existing at all: https://github.com/whatwg/streams/issues/353
  - Validate `view` https://github.com/whatwg/streams/pull/361#discussion_r32267723
  - [x] pull + pullInto or just pullInto #363
- [x] Underlying byte source/controller design: return a promise vs. c.something: https://github.com/whatwg/streams/issues/354
- [x] enqueue() should check type or not
- [x] Reference implementation/tests
- [ ] Add RBS to the templated tests
- [x] Sync spec and reference implementation
- [x] Use "perform" for abstract ops that cannot throw (do #366 for RBS)
- [x] #74 will be closable once we have byte streams in the draft
